LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Chr. ac.]
Drawing, deep-seated pain, as if in bone, in upper half of left thigh, in front, extending to hip joint.
In bed a severe quivering, boring, deep-seated pain in inner side of thighs, chiefly left. *
A dull, bruised, fatigued feeling in legs, especially above knees, with some pain on firm pressure ; for several days. *
Pains in knee. *
A kind of twitching in left knee joint.
In afternoon a rheumatic feeling in right knee joint, continuing till 10 P. M.
Knee joints weak and knocking.
Weakness of left knee joint, knocking a little when walking.
Sensation of paralysis from right knee down.
Occasionally indistinct pains like a strain about feet and ankles. *
Sharp drawing pains in bones and ligaments of right foot. *
Shooting, drawing pains about balls of feet. *
Itching and drawing pains in balls of feet, at root of toes, painful on treading on ground. *
Itching in feet, toes and various parts in evening.
Burning and itching in toes like chilblains.
Cold feet, with fulness in head, giddiness, and with chest symptoms.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Chr. ac.]
Uneasiness, stiffness and dull pain in muscles, in morning ; chiefly in shoulder blades and back of neck, also between shoulders and in hips ; coming occasionally during day until evening.
Cold hands and feet.
Rheumatic attacks.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Chr. ac.]
In bed : severe pain in thighs.
On lying on heart : painful sensation on deep inspiration.
On lying down : cannot fall asleep.
Sitting or lying still : > pain in right side from lumbar region round to cecum.
Rising from a lying position caused much pain.
After rising : in morning, uneasiness in bowels > ; pain in loins and right side >.
Obliged to change position during pain between head, left shoulder blade and shoulder.
At night sleep was impaired, as only certain positions were endurable.
Obliged to get up and walk about : after attack of toothache ; in evening.
Movement of trunk brings on violent pain in right side from lumbar region round to cecum.
While walking : lightness in head.
Quick walking : gives relief ; > the nausea which precedes each attack of vomiting.
On going down-stairs : giddiness.
On turning on right side : pain in chest better.
The slightest motion of affected parts was very painful.
   

NERVES. [36] [Chr. ac.]
Tiredness and weakness.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Chr. ac.]
Notwithstanding good sleep at night, great sleepiness in daytime ; but if he lies down for a nap, cannot fall asleep.
Excessively sleepy one hour before bedtime.
Fell asleep late.
Wakes up at early dawn and cannot fall asleep.
Going to sleep late, much restlessness and very anxious dreams, dreams not recollected.
Vivid dreams ; awoke early with pains suddenly shifting to various parts of trunk ; dull pain at one time at inferior angles of scapulæ, then pressure in right hypochondrium, at edge of false ribs, then in region of bladder ; pain, dull, pressive, over right eye. *
Had a dream in morning, with pain under apex of heart, which awoke him. *
Dreams much all night ; he rides on horseback through a stream, and after crossing the water it freezes on him.
Dreams unpleasant ; about to be put to death by poison, while innocent of crime.
Dreamed that he had an attack of strangury, which the next morning proved to be the fact, and which he did not get over for two hours.
   

TIME. [38] [Chr. ac.]
At night : cutting pains across left eyeball ; toothache ; sore throat awakens ; retching cough and sore throat ; itching in armpits ; good sleep ; dreams much.
At 2 A. M. : pulse 48.
At 4 A. M. : woke with sick feeling in abdomen.
At 5 A. M. : fulness in upper and forepart of head ; awoke very restless ; could not lie quiet five minutes ; boring pain in left side of chest ; angina.
In morning : in bed, flow of tears, with cutting pain across l. eyeball ; on waking dull, pressive pain over right eye ; toothache ; hawking of phlegm ; nausea ; pains in left hypochondrium ; uneasiness in bowels before rising ; pain in loins and right side ; pulse 72 ; pain at inferior angles of both scapulæ ; in bed, lumbar pain < ; pain in left scapula < ; transitory pains in elbows ; itching in palm of hand ; uneasiness, stiffness and pain in muscles ; had a dream.
At 6 A. M. : nausea ; sharp pain in hypogastric region and along ascending colon.
In forenoon : dull confusion in head.
At 10 o'clock : lightness in head.
From 10 A. M. to 4 P. M. : pain along coronal suture ; cold sensation in back of neck.
Middle of day : unusual hunger.
Afternoon : ranula with dry mouth ; pulse 62 to 64 ; 58 to 75 ; rheumatic feeling in right knee.
From 2 to 4 P. M. : qualmishness.
All day : pain over left eye.
In daytime : pulsation through chest with cold feet ; sleepiness.
In evening : lightness at heart as of a vacuum ; smarting and heaviness in eyelids ; smarting in eyelids with pricking in skin ; pain-like flatulence ; pain in region of heart ; pulse 62 to 64 ; pain at inner angle of left scapula ; itching of feet and various parts ; pricking and itching here and there ; uneasiness in limbs.
At 10 P. M. : violent toothache.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Chr. ac.]
The least draught of air < pain.
Warmth : does not > pain along coronal suture.
Cold : does not > pain along coronal suture.
Cold water : produced pain in teeth ; pain < by.
Cold water and a strong draught of air cause or increase pain.
Walking in open air : did not > pain along coronal suture.
   

FEVER. [40] [Chr. ac.]
Cold head and feet.
Sensation of general coldness which continued for one week ; could not get warm at all.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Chr. ac.]
For a second : sudden jerk of eyeballs.
Appears and disappears suddenly : sensation as of water in right ear.
Transitory : pains in elbows.
At intervals of 5 to 10 minutes : retching and vomiting.
Lasting 10 to 15 minutes : attacks of toothache.
After several minutes : sudden stitches in region of heart gradually disappear.
Lasting half an hour : pain in hypogastric region and along ascending colon.
For two hours : pain over top of left shoulder ; attack of strangury.
Lasting three hours : morning diarrhœa.
Throughout day : pain in left scapula ; occasionally pains in muscles until evening.
For two days : mind in a state of confusion.
For one week : sensation of coldness.
For three weeks : deep-seated pain with distress, at times more severe, at others less, in left shoulder and neck.
Periodical : ranula.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Chr. ac.]
Pains < on left side and lasting longer than on the right.
Left : shooting pains in temple ; pulsative throbbing from region of heart to eye and side of head ; slight pains in hypochondrium with fulness of head ; cutting pains across eyeball ; throbbing in eye ; dull pain over eye ; sudden jerking pains in ear ; cold feeling in meatus ; pain in undecayed teeth ; toothache in lower jaw ; pain over whole upper part of chest on coughing ; boring pain in side of chest below axilla ; deep-seated pain in back of chest ; stitch in upper part of chest on drawing a long breath ; slight pain in lung ; twitching in knee joint ; deep-seated pain with distress in shoulder, shoulder blade and neck ; pain moved from shoulder blade down to pelvis ; dull pain at inner angle of scapula ; jerking pains in ear ; shooting pain into hip bone ; dull aching pain over top of shoulder ; pain in scapula ; transient pain in elbow ; short-lasting, growing pain with lameness in brachium ; drawing, deep-seated pain in upper half of thigh ; twitching in knee ; weakness of knee joint.
Right : lightness in head inclines him to side when walking ; dull, pressive pain over eye on awaking in morning ; pain from eyeball and aching teeth into anterior portion of brain ; as of water in ear ; dulness and uneasy feeling in eye and nostril ; pressive pain over eye in morning ; violent toothache after going to bed ; teeth feel too long after toothache ; toothache in lower jaw ; from lumbar region round to cecum, pain like flatulence ; pain in loins and side ; rheumatic pains about shoulder ; sharp shooting to crest of ilium ; short lasting pain in elbow ; itching in palm of hand ; rheumatic feeling in knee ; sensation of paralysis from knee down ; drawing pains in bones and ligaments of foot ; pressure in hypochondrium ; dull, pressive pain over eye.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Chr. ac.]
As of a vacuum at heart ; of tiredness and weakness ; as of water in ear ; as if painful teeth were too long ; as if root of lung could not expand and was painful on deep inspiration ; as from a severe blow in middle of left brachium ; as of paralysis from right knee down ; as if exhaled air smelled putrid.
Pain : from teeth and right eyeball into anterior brain ; in left hypochondrium ; from toothache, extends into ear and forehead ; between head, left shoulder-blade and shoulder ; in teeth, from cold water ; in hypogastric region and along ascending colon ; in colon ; like flatulence, in right side from lumbar region round to cecum ; in loins and right side ; over whole upper left part of chest ; in left lung ; under apex of heart ; from left shoulder blade down to pelvis ; in back and loins ; in lumbar region ; in small of back ; in left scapula ; in elbows ; in legs, especially above knees, on firm pressure ; in knee ; at root of toes on treading on ground ; suddenly shifting to various parts of trunk.
Cutting : across left eyeball.
Boring : in left side of chest below axilla ; about fourth rib ; in inner side of thighs, chiefly the left.
Stitch : in left chest near shoulder ; in region of heart, sudden and violent.
Shooting : in left temple ; in epigastrium ; from small of back into left hip bone ; from lumbar vertebræ to crest of ilium on right side ; about balls of feet.
Pricking : in tongue ; in skin ; in various parts.
Drawing : in left scapula ; in upper half of left thigh ; as if in the bone, extending to hip joint ; in bones and ligaments of right foot ; about balls of feet.
Burning : superficial, about middle dorsal spines, in toes like chilblains.
Sudden jerking : in left ear ; of both eyeballs.
Sudden violent pain : in teeth in left side.
Fine drawing, nervous pain in region of heart, at times reaching through chest to shoulder and neck.
Quivering pains : in inner side of thighs, chiefly the left.
Soreness : of orb to touch ; of eyes as if inflamed ; of mouth when chewing ; of throat ; in chest.
Deep-seated pain : in back and front of left side of chest ; in left shoulder, shoulder blade, and left part of back of neck up to occiput ; in hands and fingers ; in upper half of left thigh, in front, extending to hip joint ; in inner side of thighs, chiefly the left.
Pressive pain : at apex of heart ; in right hypochondrium.
Dull, pressive pain : over right eye.
Dull, aching pain : over top of left shoulder, as if from great fatigue.
Dull pain : over left eye as if headache would set in ; at inner angle of left scapula ; at inferior angles of both scapulæ ; in hands and fingers.
Heavy pain : along coronal suture ; in muscles of neck and shoulders and various parts of trunk.
Pinching : in epigastrium.
Rawness : in chest.
Smarting : in eyelids ; around eyes ; in inner canthi.
Bruised feeling : in legs, especially above knees.
Indistinct pains like a strain about feet and ankles.
Aching : in epigastrium.
Rheumatic pains : about right shoulder ; about various parts of back.
Clucking, painful sensation on deep inspiration when lying on heart.
Growing pains : in left brachium.
Transitory pains : in elbows ; in left brachium ; in various parts.
Sensitiveness : of brain ; of lumbar region.
Heaviness : in eyelids ; in stomach.
Throbbing pulsation : from region of heart to left eye and side of head ; in occiput ; in left eye ; in left lung ; through chest.
Pressure : in stomach ; on chest ; in right hypochondrium, at edge of false ribs, then in region of bladder.
Stricture : in chest, in region of heart.
Twitching : in left knee joint.
Stiffness : in muscles, chiefly in shoulder blades, back of neck ; between shoulders and in hips.
Rheumatic feeling : in right knee joint.
Sick feeling : in abdomen.
Fulness : of head ; in upper and forepart of head ; in stomach ; about rectum.
Emptiness : in chest.
Lightness : of head ; at heart as of a vacuum.
Dull feeling : in legs, especially above knees.
Fatigued feeling : in legs, especially above knees.
Weakness : in small of back ; of chest ; of knee joints ; of l. knee joint.
Lameness : in left brachium.
Falling asleep : of arms.
Uneasiness : in right eye and nostril ; in limbs ; in bowels, similar to premonitory symptoms of diarrhœa ; in muscles, chiefly in shoulder blades, back of neck, between shoulders and in hips.
Heat : in face.
Coldness : general, he cannot get warm.
Cold feeling : in small spot in meatus ; on back of neck.
Itching : around eyes ; in inner canthi ; in armpits ; in palm of right hand ; at balls of feet ; in feet, toes and various parts.
Dryness : in right eye and nostril ; of mouth.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Chr. ac.]
Inflammation and destruction of epithelium of mucous membranes.
Pseudo-membrane similar to that of angina faucium and croup.
Gangrene.
(OBS :) For disinfection of cholera and fever stools.
(OBS :) To arrest fetid discharges and correct fetid odors.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Chr. ac.]
Touch : soreness of orb to ; abdomen tender to ; muscles of shoulder blade painful to.
Pressure : a spot about an inch to right of middle lumbar spine sensitive to ; pain above knees on ; on treading on ground feet at root of toes painful.
Obliged to loosen clothes to > pressure and fulness in stomach.
(OBS :) To prevent suppuration and putrefaction in wounds.
   

SKIN. [46] [Chr. ac.]
Mostly in evening disagreeable pricking and itching here and there, with uneasiness in limbs, so that he was obliged to get up from sitting or lying and walk about.
Pricking in skin, in various parts, accompanies smarting in eyelids. *
(OBS :) Causes the disappearance of warts.
(OBS :) Hospital gangrene ; phagedenic ulcers ; bites of rabid animals ; poisoned wounds.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Chr. ac.]
Girl, æt. 14 ; watery diarrhœa.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Chr. ac.]
Workmen engaged in the manufacture of anhydro-chromate of potassium are liable to symptoms like secondary syphilis. Small doses of corrosive sublimate have been found the remedy.
Daphne indica cured the rheumatic pain.
Compare : Kali bich. derived from the same metal.
